contradiction_resolution: No claim-level contradiction: contradicts_claim_ids is empty; FND-0031 is compatible with and essentially restates the pure-weight corner of THM-0003/RED-0001. Primary check against SRC-0002 (CLP, arXiv:2307.08830v3): the right-exact sequence H^{k-2}(~partial M_{g,n}) -> H^k(Mbar_{g,n}) -> W_k H^k(M_{g,n}) -> 0 (Preliminaries) and dual BM form (6.1) H_k(~partial) -> H_k(Mbar) -> W_{-k} H_k(M) -> 0 are exactly the depth-m=0 / codimension-one Gysin cokernel. SRC-0001 (Payne 2605.20453) records the same localization-plus-weights sequence H^{k-2}(~D)(-1) -> H^k(Mbar) -> W_k H^k(M) -> 0. For the RED-0001 ordinary dual, k=2d-16 so weight=degree and m=weight-degree=0; only the m=0 term H^{2d-16}(Mbar) and d_1 Gysin from codim-1 strata H^{2d-18}(D^{(1)})(-1) contribute, so multi-edge/codim>=2 strata and higher differentials are irrelevant at this graded piece. Dualizing recovers THM-0003, hence undecorated weight-SS / Getzler-Kapranov bookkeeping at this pure corner cannot supply independent input beyond the still-unknown compactified H_{16}/H^{16} (circular for CONJ-0001). For (6,6): d=21, corner gr^W_26 H^{26}. Distinct from FND-0032 (top-weight CGP corner), FND-0033 (semisimplicity of the pure row), FND-0034 (nonsep divisor Mbar_{5,8}). Merge target: none.
